# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148, with a reworked singleton lifecycle. It adds variable font and color font palette support, animated WebP encoding, and zero-copy stream-to-data conversion. This is a breaking release for anyone still on the pre-v4 obsolete text/font APIs or Vulkan 1.0 hardware — check the changes below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy paint/font text APIs promoted to compiler errors** — Pre-v4 obsolete members on SKPaint and SKFont for reading/writing text and font state now fail to build instead of just warning. Move typeface, text size, and text-measurement calls onto SKFont/SKPaint's current APIs. ([#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205), [#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))
- **SKFont/SKPaint no longer resolve a lazy default typeface** — new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs) instead of null, so MeasureText returns 0 until you set a real typeface; new SKPaint().Typeface returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Construct SKFont with an explicit typeface and check IsEmpty instead of comparing to null. ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735), [#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and SKTypeface.Default never return null** — FromFamilyName now returns SKTypeface.Default on every platform (including Android) instead of null for an unknown family, and SKTypeface.Default is guaranteed non-null everywhere. Use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily for a strict null-on-not-found check. ([#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737), [#3738](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3738))
- **SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and now throws on overflow** — The long overload used to silently truncate offsets beyond int range; it is now [Obsolete] and throws OverflowException instead. Call Move(int) with an in-range offset. ([#3740](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3740))
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1; a sub-1.1 instance/device causes the native process to abort instead of CreateVulkan returning null. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion, and fall back to raster on genuinely 1.0-only hardware. ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))
- **Vulkan interop structs changed shape** — GRVkBackendContextNative dropped fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice (use fVkExtensions/fDeviceFeatures instead); GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo gained a new Components field, and GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, which lost value-equality. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestones 132, 133, 147, and 148** — SkiaSharp now builds on Skia m148, rolling up multiple milestone bumps and rounds of upstream chrome bug-fix syncs since the 3.x line. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Variable font and color font support** — Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, plus color font palette selection, so apps can render weight/width/palette-variable fonts directly. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream reads** — SKWebpEncoder can now write animated WebP files, and SKStream.GetData() lets callers pull stream contents into an SKData without an intermediate copy. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **GPU draw-surface sampling and native asset coverage** — SKSurface.Draw/SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions, and Linux Bionic and Tizen x64/arm64 native assets were added to the build matrix. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Missing API wrappers and naming fixes** — Adds a proper HBColor struct plus a set of missing API wrappers and naming-convention corrections found while auditing the binding surface. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel access and finalizer crashes corrected** — SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the right axis for offsets, and a finalizer ordering crash when SKPathBuilder is collected before its SKPath is fixed. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Default-typeface resolution moved to managed code** — Resolving the default typeface now happens in the managed layer instead of relying on a native path that could fail on newer Android API levels. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **MAUI and WinUI fixes** — Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch, and a missing WinUI Projection DLL that broke .NET 9 consumers. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton instance lifecycle reworked** — Reworks how SkiaSharp's native singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates expat to 2.8.1, harfbuzz to 14.2.0, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, libpng to 1.6.58, and libexpat to 2.7.5. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 gains variable font support and an HBColor value type alongside the harfbuzz 14.2.0 bundled update.

## Release Candidate 1 (June 12, 2026)

The release candidate promoted the remaining legacy text/font obsoletes to compile errors, fixed the pixmap stride/offset bugs, and reworked the singleton lifecycle ahead of the stable v4 release.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.3.1...v4.148.0-rc.1.2)

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.2.1...v4.147.0-preview.3.1)
